purpose: Teach: 美学/うかがい/異物/恥ずかしながら/相まって/のけ/汚し/勝た

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、デザインの美学を大切にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're cherishing good design in everything we do.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Purposeful pace. Slight formality—speaking from principle, not decree. Breath support under the entire phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のお話、うかがい、ご報告いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen carefully to what our customers have to say and report back to you.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Slight nod in the voice on the opening. Warm but professional. A hint of eagerness to follow through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 食品に異物混入のリスク、ゼロを目指しましょう
lines.en: We need to aim for zero risk of contamination in our food products.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Each word lands with quiet weight. Slower pace, almost meditative. No room for compromise in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 恥ずかしながら、当社の在庫管理に課題がございます
lines.en: I'm sorry to say we've found some real gaps in our inventory management.
lines.style: Humble opening, shoulders slightly forward. Honest admission without deflecting. Steady eye-contact level. Brief pause after the confession.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の好調と市況改善が相まっての業績です
lines.en: Our strong performance comes from both our own effort and the improved market conditions.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Pride tempered by realism. Distributes credit fairly across both causes. Composed, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員にのけ者感を抱かせない職場を目指します
lines.en: We want to create a workplace where no one feels left out or excluded.
lines.style: Warm, inclusive intention beneath the words. Slower, deliberate pace—making sure this lands. Sincere without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の信頼を汚した広告、撤退しましょう
lines.en: We should pull that advertisement—it damaged customer trust.
lines.style: Decisive, no hesitation. Brief pause before 'pull'—the moment of decision. Quiet seriousness. Not angry, but clear about what's right.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。他社に勝たねば、当社、存続できません
lines.en: Yes. If we don't outperform our competitors, we won't survive.
lines.style: Sobering reality check. Quiet intensity. No drama, just honest assessment. The stakes are clear in the tone.
